scientific_integrity: All accepted asymptotic and TV claims are supported by the analytic proof. Numerical checks are supplementary; no independent validation has been performed. Earliest source date is the verified original-publication date of the 1962 archival foundation, not a date of this finding.
scientific_limitations: Specific cosine density on the unit circle, n>=3; fixed positive eta and fixed lambda/n limits only. Baseline Wendel probability and three-point weighted event are antecedents. Extrapolation to arbitrary anisotropies and other rates is not established. Historical priority is not exhaustively certified.
title: Anisotropic semicircle containment and the Gaussian–von Mises crossover for random enclosing disks
